cases.title: 300-second quiet NodeHealth cadence
cases.physical_prerequisite: Matched current C3/S3 image, effective configuration, authenticated session, and reset-safe observer; observe six quiet opportunities over 30 minutes.

cases.title: Authenticated event piggyback
cases.physical_prerequisite: Authorized genuine sensor event and correlated authenticated Hub acceptance; MAC success alone is insufficient.

cases.title: 910-second offline detection and coverage classification
cases.physical_prerequisite: Matched current profile and authorized 910-second silent-Node interval with independent Hub/WAN evidence.

cases.title: Node return, rejoin, and pending-event preservation
cases.physical_prerequisite: Authorized return/rejoin observation with pending EventKey ledger captured before and after; no board reset or NVS change.

cases.title: Legacy and configured profile compatibility
cases.physical_prerequisite: Two independently identified/enrolled Nodes or an approved qualified profile fixture; one available Node is insufficient.

cases.title: Caregiver PWA online, offline, and unknown coverage
cases.physical_prerequisite: Matched real Node/Hub observations and correlated actual backend/API/PWA timestamps and caregiver-visible states.

cases.title: Serial observation reliability and fail-stop behavior
cases.physical_prerequisite: Host/replay-only case. Any future live adapter needs separate exact authorization and a verified non-resetting source.
